reviews.title: Fortnite Creator Samzirra Approves!!! TOP NOTCH
reviews.comment:
ASUS TUF Gaming GT502 Case – Real Fortnite Creator, Samzirra, APPROVED
I’ve had a lot of PC cases over the years, but this one blows them all away. It’s not just big and functional—it actually feels classy. Here’s why I’m seriously impressed:
• Heavy-duty transport straps:
• The Velcro nylon straps on top are a game-changer.
• Makes it easy to move this huge, fully loaded case without fear.
• Bonus: I thread my keyboard, mouse, and mic cords through the straps before plugging them in—keeps cables neat and prevents stress on the USB ports.
• Slick tempered glass panels:
• Tinted glass adds a premium look.
• Quick-release button system makes removing panels painless when it’s time to clean or upgrade.
• Cooling capacity (aka jet engine mode):
• Case supports up to 13 fans, but I took it further—mine has 18 installed!
• (3 top, 3 bottom, 3 side, 3 behind the motherboard, 3 in the GPU, 1 SSD fan, 1 PSU fan, plus the main exhaust).
• If you’re worried about airflow, don’t be—this thing is a wind tunnel.
• Upgrade-friendly:
• Tons of room for expansion.
• Behind the motherboard: extra SSD slots, fan mounts, and clean cable routing.
• Future-proofed for serious upgrades and pro-level builds.
• Overall impression:
• Stylish, practical, and incredibly functional.
• Perfect for gamers, streamers, or anyone hauling around high-end components.
• Honestly, it’s one of the best cases I’ve ever owned—looks amazing and works even better.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (Easily 5 stars. If I could give it more, I would.)

reviews.title: Built like a tank
reviews.comment: This thing is built like a tank. It offers an excellent view, tons of space for working inside the case, great airflow, good cable management and allows up to 10 case fans to be installed. This does not include the GPU or AIO, in which case it would bring the total up to 16. It's an excellent case all in all. I had zero issues building in this case. For my next build, I will purchase the white GT502 Horizon.

reviews.title: Best case in it's class
reviews.comment:
I really like this design. Although similar to a Lian Li 011 (and others) in layout, this is a far superior product. Every aspect was thought of and well planned. From the release of the side panels, the top cover's magnetic retention, to the way the radiator rack on the top pivots out, EVERYTHING was designed and made by someone who, like me, build PC's on a regular basis. I've Been building PC's since 1990 and have seen a lot of good and bad over the decades. This is by far the best case I have ever used.  I had to track a wire with a bad connection and within seconds I was able to remove a few panels and move a radiator to find the offending connection. All that without cutting up my hands or popping a zip-tie. The GPU vertical mount kit works better than any other I've used and the included anti-sag was a really nice, effective bonus.
I initially thought the straps on top were cheap gimmick until I started using them. Today, most high-end components are full of heatsinks, heat pipes, radiators and chunks of metal just to look cool. A  motherboard and radiator can be 20 pounds, before you add in the heft of a video card. Instead of putting that weight into the meat of your hands while grabbing onto metal and glass corners, lifting by the straps is so much easier and less likely to do damage (to you or the case). This has changed how I do a lot of things, and all for the better. My hat's off to Asus on this one I don't know how they will top it, but for now this will be the only tower I recommend.
